## Who we are

We are a part of Bosch Building Technologies, specializing in the development and provision of
advanced fire alarm and life safety systems designed to protect people, property, and assets.
Through collaboration with our international partners, we provide innovative and reliable products
to customers around the globe.

In selected countries, Bosch Building Technologies also operates an experienced system integrator
business, offering solutions and services for building security, energy efficiency, and building
automation. For more information on the integrator business, visit the [Bosch Building Technologies
page][77].

### GoodVision FAQ

What types of cameras does GoodVision software support?

We’re camera-agnostic and support standard CCTV and IP cameras, including popular brands like
Hikvision and Axis. We also support drones, please [**contact us** ][73]if you have specific cameras
you’re unsure about.

What resolution and FPS do I need?
* The minimum supported resolution is 640×480 px at 10 fps, but using such low resolutions may cause
  objects to appear blurry or lack sufficient detail for accurate detection.
* Recommended: Full HD (1920×1080) at 25–30 FPS
What’s the optimal camera placement?

Ideally between 8–12 meters in height, with a clear top-down or diagonal view of traffic flow.

How long does processing take?

Typically within a couple of hours, depending on video quality and platform load. It’s fully
automated.

Can GoodVision AI work at night or in low light?

Yes — provided the scene is visibly clear. Cameras with wide dynamic range (WDR) work best at night.

Can I use drone footage?

Yes — 4K resolution is ideal, especially for footage captured from heights up to 250 meters. Footage
from ~50m also works well.

Can I edit or export reports?

Yes — reports can be edited, regenerated, and exported in Excel, CSV, or custom formats depending on
your needs.

Is ANPR available?

Yes — effective with high-resolution (UHD/4K) footage, 25–30 FPS, and visible plates (350+ pixels in
size).

Can I define custom vehicle types?

Yes — we support custom classification schemes (e.g., tuk-tuks, e-scooters). Reach out to configure
yours.

Can GoodVision detect risks or near collisions (PET/TTC)?

Yes — the system can calculate key safety metrics like Post-Encroachment Time (PET) and Time to
Collision (TTC).

[**Contact us**][74] for more details.

Can I manage a full traffic study project on the platform?

Yes — you can handle everything from upload to final report, including sharing results with
stakeholders.

Do you offer a free trial?

Yes. Apply for a free trial directly [**here.**][75]

Why Milestone?
We have been around for more than 25 years. And while our video technology continuously evolves, our
longevity and success are built on three core pillars.
[https://mswebappcdn.azureedge.net/episerverprod/5359659aa98b48dc93a38ba95258f819/c54060d88c2a4579be
8b4a5089735bbf.png]
Responsible
We are committed to doing our part to help ensure emerging technologies are only used for the
benefit of society. We believe that ethical behavior is inseparable from the business of video
technology software.
[https://mswebappcdn.azureedge.net/episerverprod/0027a888683445a292b18e54ba103750/860eaa1363f0429fa8
b5e63bb210c944.png]
People first
Our culture, products and partnerships are all about people. That means we consider the needs and
well-being of people and the greater social good in all aspects of our business and operations.
[https://mswebappcdn.azureedge.net/episerverprod/952100e1cace4928ab37a507b3bae374/1591ed9f98f94e22a6
65aeef2e185b4d.png]
Pioneering
We first set the bar for video technology in 1998. And we continue to raise it through the
flexibility of our open-platform software, and the most secure and stable VMS on the market.
‎

Get in touch with us if you have questions, want to become a partner, or need help.

## Our Services

### Programs and services that support safe, efficient travel across Northeast Florida.

[RTMC operators monitoring traffic across Northeast Florida from a control room]

#### Traffic Management

Traffic operations are monitored and managed twenty-four hours a day, seven days a week across
eighteen counties including Duval, St Johns, Alachua, Columbia, Clay, and Nassau, using signal
timing, express lane operations, and work zone traffic management strategies.

[Explore Traffic Operations][61]
[Road Ranger patrol vehicle positioned to support safety and traffic flow.]

#### Incident Management

Rapid incident response and coordinated traffic clearance help keep roadways safe and traffic
moving. Programs such as Road Rangers, Safe Tow, Traffic Incident Management (TIM), and RISC work
together to reduce delays and restore normal travel conditions as quickly as possible.

[View Incident Response][62]
[Dynamic message sign displaying real-time traffic information on a Florida highway]

#### Traveler Information

Real-time traveler information helps drivers stay informed and make safer travel decisions. Tools
such as FL511, dynamic message signs, travel time systems, and social media provide updates on
traffic conditions, incidents, and roadway activity throughout the region.

[Access Travel Updates][63]
[Autonomous FDOT shuttle bus driving on a public roadway as part of an emerging transportation
technology initiative.]

#### Initiatives and Emerging Technologies

Innovative transportation solutions address current and future traffic demands across the region.
Programs include Intelligent Transportation Systems initiatives such as wrong-way driving detection,
connected vehicles, and truck parking information systems.

[Discover Innovations][64]

### Stay Informed on Current Traffic Conditions

View active traffic incidents and access the live traffic camera map to monitor conditions across
Northeast Florida.

[See List of Incidents][65]

## Our Services

### Programs and services that support safe, efficient travel across Northeast Florida.

[RTMC operators monitoring traffic across Northeast Florida from a control room]

#### Traffic Management

Traffic operations are monitored and managed twenty-four hours a day, seven days a week across
eighteen counties including Duval, St Johns, Alachua, Columbia, Clay, and Nassau, using signal
timing, express lane operations, and work zone traffic management strategies.

[Explore Traffic Operations][61]
[Road Ranger patrol vehicle positioned to support safety and traffic flow.]

#### Incident Management

Rapid incident response and coordinated traffic clearance help keep roadways safe and traffic
moving. Programs such as Road Rangers, Safe Tow, Traffic Incident Management (TIM), and RISC work
together to reduce delays and restore normal travel conditions as quickly as possible.

[View Incident Response][62]
[Dynamic message sign displaying real-time traffic information on a Florida highway]

#### Traveler Information

Real-time traveler information helps drivers stay informed and make safer travel decisions. Tools
such as FL511, dynamic message signs, travel time systems, and social media provide updates on
traffic conditions, incidents, and roadway activity throughout the region.

[Access Travel Updates][63]
[Autonomous FDOT shuttle bus driving on a public roadway as part of an emerging transportation
technology initiative.]

Innovative transportation solutions address current and future traffic demands across the region.
Programs include Intelligent Transportation Systems initiatives such as wrong-way driving detection,
connected vehicles, and truck parking information systems.

that opened in 2015 to manage traffic in Florida Department of Transportation’s (FDOT) District Two.
The RTMC houses multiple partner agencies that all work together to operate and manage the
multimodal transportation network for Northeast Florida.

operations across the City of Jacksonville.

# A well-timed warning
# A little less stress

A timely warning on speed cameras and road hazards makes for a little less stress on every drive

[Explore CO-DRIVER NO2][23]

## Less uncertainty
## Less stress

Speed cameras, road hazards - the CO-DRIVER tells you what's ahead before you get there. Just focus
on driving, not on watching for what might catch you off guard.

## CO-DRIVER NO2
## Europe's most sold

You want to know what awaits on your route, right? Well, this little device makes sure you do. It’s
relevant traffic information shared by millions of fellow drivers.

[Explore the CO-DRIVER NO2][24]
* Speed camera warnings
* Road hazard warnings
* Apple CarPlay/Android Auto
* Navigation
* Rechargeable battery
[Explore the CO-DRIVER NO2][25]

## One step ahead
## in traffic

Play video 00:30

## It's the small things
## that get you

A missed sign. A speed camera you didn't see. A hazard around the bend. A car braking hard up ahead.
Driving is a hundred small surprises a day, and they add up - not in a good way. That little "what's
coming next?" is what can turn a calm drive into a stressful one.

Now, we can't fix traffic. Or take away every surprise on the road. But we can warn you about what
the road brings. So you can stop watching for the small stuff, and just focus on driving.

[Explore CO-DRIVER NO2][26]

## We've got other
## fan favorites

ring, designed to alert you about speed cameras and provide live traffic info, displayed against a
plain white background.]

## Automatic trip tracking **with your CO-DRIVER**

No forgotten trips. No spreadsheet chaos.
No bus rides or bike trips cluttering your log. Just get in and drive.

[Explore Mileage Book][27]
[A person with curly hair, wearing a beige jacket and orange sleeves, leans on the open door of a
car with a speed camera detector, smiling. An orange building with black-framed windows is in the
background.]

## Making every drive
## a little less stressful

## About OOONO
## A little less stress

We're not fixing traffic. We're just make it a little less stressful

It all started with simple a: Drivers helping drivers. So in 2017, we built the CO-DRIVER - a small
device that lets millions of people warn each other about what's up the road. Speed cameras. Road
hazards.

The kind of small surprises that turn a calm drive into a stressful one. 8 years and 5 million
drivers later, we're still on the same idea: Knowing what the road brings is one less thing to
stress about.

provide up-to-the-minute traffic status updates across major IT corridors and residential hubs —
from heavy congestion at **Hinjewadi IT Park** and **Bhumkar Chowk** in the West to busy transit
points like **Mundhwa Bridge**, **Kharadi**, and **Magarpatta** in the East.

at **Chandni Chowk**, we monitor 20+ critical chokepoints every 10 minutes to deliver proactive
traffic alerts. Whether you’re commuting via the **Mumbai–Pune Expressway** service roads,
navigating **Nal Stop**, or checking road closures during monsoon waterlogging, our no-login,
high-speed PWA helps you avoid peak-hour jams.

## What is TetherX?

Cameras, alarms and access from any manufacturer - one Cloud VMS, fitted by your local certified
partner.

WHAT

### An open Cloud VMS for every security system

Bring cameras, alarm panels and door readers from 1,000+ integrations into one app - with TetherX
cloud storage, AI search and health monitoring on top.

WHY

### Open beats locked-in

Most platforms lock you into their own cameras and bill you forever. TetherX runs whatever is on the
wall - mix brands, swap kit anytime, no rip-and-replace.

HOW

### Delivered by a local certified installer

A small TetherBox bridge sits on your network and connects existing kit to the cloud. A certified
local TetherX partner scopes it, fits it and supports it - not a chatbot in another timezone.

[ See what open, software-first security looks like ][65]
[ Or the 11 reasons TetherX means business ][66]

Cameras, alarms and access on one Cloud VMS - whichever side of the install you sit on.

Manage security across multiple sites from one dashboard.

Instant alerts on your phone when issues arise

# Watch All 145,000+ Live Traffic Cameras & Feeds Worldwide

TrafficVision.Live is a fast, modern **tool for watching live traffic cameras and planning your
drive**. Browse **145,000+ live cameras from 600+ official sources across 130+ countries and all 7
continents**: highway cams, **live street cameras**, and **live road cameras** from Caltrans
(California), TxDOT (Texas), FDOT (Florida), 511NY (New York Thruway), CDOT (Colorado), MDOT, ODOT,
TDOT SmartWay, PennDOT, WSDOT, and 590+ other DOT and 511 systems.

Check highway conditions before your commute, watch a **highway camera live** over a mountain pass,
monitor airport runways, or explore city streets around the world. All from one interactive map.
TrafficVision.Live is the largest free public directory of live cameras, built as a tool you
actually want to use. No account required, no paywalls, no signup.

What you can do
* **Search and filter** 145,000+ live cameras by location, state, country, or feed type.
* **Build custom routes** at [trafficvision.live/routes][1] and track every camera along your drive.
* **Watch live video** streams, refreshing images, and YouTube feeds on the interactive [world
  map][2].
* **See AI overlays** on live video: vehicle bounding boxes, real-time car counts, and automatic
  crash and traffic detection on screen.
* **Track the ISS** live camera as it orbits Earth in real time.
* **Follow cruise ships** with live onboard cameras and vessel positions.
CamGuessr: live-camera guessing game

[CamGuessr][3] is a free GeoGuessr-style game built into TrafficVision.Live. Watch a live traffic
camera feed and guess its location on the map. Three game modes:
* **Classic.** 5 rounds, pin your guess on a world map, scored by distance (up to 5,000 points per
  round).
* **Streak.** Endless rounds, but score below 1,000 points and the game ends.
* **Country.** 5 rounds, guess which country the camera is in (1,000 points for correct, 250 for
  neighbouring countries).

CamGuessr filters through TrafficVision.Live's 145,000+ cameras to find eligible live video feeds
from 130+ countries, with each stream tested in real time before the round starts to ensure a
working feed. Submit your score to the global leaderboard.

  more.
* [State and region guides][5]: all 50 US states, Canadian provinces, and European regions.
* [Country guides][6]: United States, Canada, UK, France, Germany, Japan, Australia, and more.
* [Highway and travel guides][7]: interstate cameras, road trip planning, and border crossings.
* [How-to guides][8]: using traffic cameras for commuting, fleet management, and weather monitoring.

TrafficVision.Live aggregates every U.S. state DOT camera network into one map. Browse the largest
state camera systems:
* [Caltrans cameras][9]: 8,500+ live California traffic cameras.
* [TxDOT cameras][10]: 7,200+ Texas traffic feeds (DriveTexas).
* [NY Thruway and 511NY cameras][11]: 4,500+ New York traffic feeds.
* [FDOT and 511FL cameras][12]: live Florida highway and street feeds.
* [TDOT SmartWay cameras][13]: 2,400+ Tennessee live cams.
* [MDOT (Michigan) cameras][14]: Mi Drive live feeds across Michigan.
* [ODOT (Ohio) cameras][15]: OHGO live Ohio traffic feeds.
* [CDOT cameras][16]: live Colorado COtrip feeds and mountain pass cams.
* [All 50 state 511 cameras][17]: unified guide to every U.S. 511 system.

from 130+ countries, with each stream tested in real time before the round starts to ensure a
working feed. Submit your score to the global leaderboard.

Traffic camera guides
* [City guides][4]: live cameras for Seattle, NYC, Los Angeles, Chicago, Toronto, London, and 800+
  more.
* [State and region guides][5]: all 50 US states, Canadian provinces, and European regions.
* [Country guides][6]: United States, Canada, UK, France, Germany, Japan, Australia, and more.
* [Highway and travel guides][7]: interstate cameras, road trip planning, and border crossings.
* [How-to guides][8]: using traffic cameras for commuting, fleet management, and weather monitoring.
State DOT camera networks

TrafficVision.Live aggregates every U.S. state DOT camera network into one map. Browse the largest
state camera systems:
* [Caltrans cameras][9]: 8,500+ live California traffic cameras.
* [TxDOT cameras][10]: 7,200+ Texas traffic feeds (DriveTexas).
* [NY Thruway and 511NY cameras][11]: 4,500+ New York traffic feeds.
* [FDOT and 511FL cameras][12]: live Florida highway and street feeds.
* [TDOT SmartWay cameras][13]: 2,400+ Tennessee live cams.
* [MDOT (Michigan) cameras][14]: Mi Drive live feeds across Michigan.
* [ODOT (Ohio) cameras][15]: OHGO live Ohio traffic feeds.
* [CDOT cameras][16]: live Colorado COtrip feeds and mountain pass cams.
* [All 50 state 511 cameras][17]: unified guide to every U.S. 511 system.

Frequently asked questions
Are TrafficVision.Live's live traffic cameras free?
Yes. All 145,000+ live traffic cameras on TrafficVision.Live are free to watch. No account required,
no paywalls, no signup. Browse highway cams, street feeds, and live road cameras from any device.
How many live traffic cameras are available worldwide?
TrafficVision.Live aggregates 145,000+ real-time traffic cameras from 600+ official sources,
including Caltrans, TxDOT, FDOT, 511NY (NY Thruway), CDOT, MDOT, ODOT, TDOT SmartWay, and transport
authorities across 130+ countries on all 7 continents.
What's the difference between traffic cameras and street cameras?
They refer to the same kind of feed: live cameras showing road conditions. "Traffic cameras" usually
emphasize highways and freeways. "Live street cameras" often imply urban intersections and surface
roads. TrafficVision.Live aggregates both highway-level and street-level live feeds in one map.
Can I watch live highway cameras from any U.S. state?
Yes. Every U.S. state DOT camera network is on TrafficVision.Live, including Caltrans, TxDOT, FDOT,
GDOT, NYSDOT, CDOT, MDOT, ODOT, PennDOT, WSDOT, and 40+ others. Use the state filter or open the
[state guides][18] for a full camera list per state.
Does TrafficVision.Live include 511 cameras?
Yes. TrafficVision.Live unifies all 50 state [511 systems][19], including 511NY, 511FL, 511CA,
511GA, 511PA, 511MN, and 45 others, into one searchable live map.
What's the best way to monitor traffic for a daily commute?
Use the [route builder][20]. Enter your start and destination, and TrafficVision.Live lists every
live traffic camera along your drive. Save the route to check it daily, and bookmark
frequently-watched cameras as favorites for one-tap access.
What's the AI overlay on TrafficVision.Live video feeds?
TrafficVision.Live runs computer vision on live video cameras to draw bounding boxes around vehicles
and other objects, show real-time vehicle counts on screen, and automatically flag crashes and
unusual traffic conditions. The overlays appear directly on the video feed.

AI-powered solutions can work both independently and in concert to manage risks.

integrators, consultants, distributors, dealers and installers—and their collective expertise—around
the world. We’re committed to helping our partners in our shared mission: to keep people, property,
and assets safe.

We provide a higher level of commitment to and integration for all your physical and digital
security needs.

needs of our customers.

leverage our sales teams and market on a global scale.
